root_cause: The project-visible, active netlify_mcp connected account could not be admitted by Composio's v3.1 tool_router/session toolkit allowlist (provider HTTP 400), despite OIDC success and an exact active connected account on the second page. The exact provider-specific policy reason is not disclosed; direct account-pinned tool execution is a documented supported alternative to the failing session interface.
intervention: Use only the official Composio v3.1 direct tool endpoint with the same Supabase Vault project key, explicit connected_account_id and user_id, fixed allowed Netlify tool slugs and fixed site ID. OIDC main repo/ref/workflow verification remains mandatory. For health, execute only Netlify get-project and require exact site identity; never invoke deploy-site on health. For runtime fallback, execute only deploy-site to issue a short-lived authorized proxy.
prevention: Keep health/read-only and provider-deploy paths separate; reject provider auth, invalid schema, missing account, wrong site and failed tool response. Preserve protected GitHub CI/CodeQL and exact production provider readback before resolving the incident.
